Name: Butterfly Tapper
Author: sproggen
Description:
Change the tapper into an animated butterfly, includes 6 colours. This mod requires the "Alternative Textures" mod to work, use the paintbucket tool on a tapper in-game to choose whichever colour butterfly you like.

To install just unzip the file and drag the contents into your Mods folder.

Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Unzip and drag contents straight into your Mods folder
